title: Apartment Management System
summary: Units, tenants, leases, monthly bills and payments in one system, with a portal where tenants check their balance and send repair requests.
builtFor: A property owner with rental units
overview: Rent, water and electricity were tracked in a notebook and a spreadsheet, so preparing the monthly bills took hours and it was hard to see who still owed money.

The system creates each month's bills from the leases and meter readings, records payments with proof of payment, and shows the owner which units are occupied, vacant or overdue. Tenants sign in to their own portal to see their bills, upload payments and send maintenance requests.
features: Units by floor with their status: occupied, vacant or under repair
Tenant records and leases with start and end dates and deposits
Monthly bills generated from the rent and the water and electricity readings
Payments with proof-of-payment upload and receipts
Overdue tracking and email reminders before the due date
Tenant portal for bills, payment history and maintenance requests
Owner dashboard for occupancy and monthly collections
Row level security, so each tenant only sees their own records

title: Electronic Medical Records (EMR)
summary: Patient records for a small clinic: appointments, consultation notes, vital signs, prescriptions and lab results, with access limited by role.
overview: The clinic used paper charts, so finding a patient's history took time and records could be misplaced. Prescriptions were written by hand.

The EMR keeps each patient's visits, vital signs, diagnoses, prescriptions and lab results in one record. The front desk manages appointments and the waiting room, doctors write consultation notes and print prescriptions, and every change is saved in an audit log.
features: Patient records with history, allergies and current medicines
Appointment calendar per doctor and a waiting-room queue
Consultation notes in SOAP format with ICD-10 diagnoses
Vital signs with charts over time
Prescriptions with allergy warnings, printed or saved as PDF
Lab results attached to the patient record
Access by role (doctor, nurse, front desk, admin) and an audit log

title: Medicine Portal
summary: An online portal where customers reserve medicines for pickup, and pharmacy staff manage stock, expiry dates and prescription checks.
overview: Customers had to call or visit to ask if a medicine was in stock, and staff checked quantities and expiry dates by hand.

Customers now search the catalog, reserve medicines and upload a prescription when one is needed. Staff approve prescriptions, prepare the orders and send a text when an order is ready. Stock is tracked per batch, and reservations take from the batch that expires first.
features: Medicine catalog with search by brand or generic name
Reservations for pickup, with prescription photo upload
Prescription check by the pharmacist before an order is prepared
Order board: new, checking, preparing, ready for pickup
Stock per batch with low-stock and near-expiry alerts
Reservations take stock from the batch that expires first
Text message to the customer when an order is ready
Sales and inventory reports

title: IT Helpdesk Ticketing System
summary: A web-based helpdesk where staff report IT problems and the IT team assigns, tracks and resolves them in one place.
builtFor: The IT office of a local school
overview: IT requests used to come in through chat messages, phone calls and walk-ins, so some were lost and few were followed up. The system gives every request a ticket with a category, a priority, an owner and a status.
Staff submit tickets through a short form. The IT team works from a ticket queue and a dashboard that shows open work and the kinds of problems that come up most often.
features: Ticket form with categories for network, printer, computer, LMS and database issues
Status workflow: New, In progress, Closed
Low, medium and high priority levels
AI-assisted category and priority suggestions
Admin dashboard with charts by status, priority, category and history
Reports and user management with roles
In-app notifications for new and updated tickets

title: Business Websites
summary: Responsive websites for small businesses with menus, services, prices and booking or inquiry forms, built to load fast and be easy to update.
overview: A small business needs a site that looks right on a phone, shows its services and prices clearly, and makes it easy to book a visit or send an inquiry.

I design and build each site, connect the forms, set up the domain and hosting, and hand it over with short instructions for updates. The screens here are sample designs in the same style, with made-up businesses.
features: Responsive design for phones, tablets and desktops
Booking, inquiry and contact forms
Menus, services, prices and galleries
SEO basics and social share previews
Fast loading with optimized images
Domain, hosting and deployment setup

title: Workflow Automations
summary: Scheduled jobs and integrations that take over repetitive work: reminders, reports, spreadsheet imports, backups and form-to-database syncs.
builtFor: Small businesses, clinics and school offices
overview: Small offices lose hours every week sending reminders, copying form entries into spreadsheets and preparing the same reports.

I turn these tasks into small automations that run on a schedule or when something happens, such as a form submission. Every run is logged, failed steps are retried, and the admin gets an alert if a step still fails.
features: Email and text reminders for bills and appointments
Weekly reports emailed as a PDF
Website and form entries saved to the database
Spreadsheet imports on a schedule
Low-stock alerts for inventory
Nightly database backups to cloud storage
Run history with retries and failure alerts
